title: Partition Array for Maximum Sum
goal: Partition the array into blocks of length at most k to maximize the sum after each block is replaced by its maximum.
strategy: For each prefix end, try all allowed final-block lengths. Track that block maximum while extending backward, then combine its replaced sum with the best earlier prefix.
